# sfcompute_workspace (Data Source)

Reads workspace from SF Compute (`GET /v2/workspaces/{id}`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Workspace ID or resource path

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `name` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a workspace resource. Format: sfc:workspace:<account>:<name>.
